period_note: BASIS BREAK FROM THE MAIN SERIES: this filing prints ONLY Consolidated statements (NRB Bank PLC and its subsidiary NRB Bank Securities PLC) -- unlike the 2024 Q1-Q3 interim filings (which printed both Consolidated and Separate/Bank-only statements on the same compact page) and unlike this dataset's main Q4/annual series (Solo/Separate, per sources.json), no Separate/Bank-only Balance Sheet or P&L appears anywhere in this document (confirmed: the single page contains the Consolidated statements plus 'Selected explanatory notes' only, no second statement set). This is therefore CONSOLIDATED, flagged explicitly per the project's Solo-preference rule, and is NOT directly comparable to the Solo-basis 2024_Q1/Q2/Q3.json files in this same dataset for balance-sheet-level figures (income-statement figures are less affected, since the subsidiary NRB Bank Securities PLC is small relative to the Bank). Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE from 1 January 2025 (column headed '01 January to March 2025'). EPS is plain 'Earnings per share (EPS)', not annualized -- per Note 3.8, computed as PAT / weighted-average ordinary shares outstanding (690,587,200). Consolidated Balance Sheet identity verified to within rounding (Total Liabilities 94,901,183,207 + Total Shareholders' Equity 8,806,646,744 = 103,707,829,951 vs stated Total Assets 103,707,829,952, a 1-taka rounding difference, immaterial). NOTABLE: Commission, exchange and brokerage is NEGATIVE this quarter (-20,159,775) -- confirmed via a 300dpi precision crop of the source (not a transcription error) -- a reversal/net-loss on this income line rather than the typical positive contribution seen in every other quarter in this dataset.
